videos.title: How Big of a Problem is Voter Fraud?: Crash Course US Government #6
videos.author: CrashCourse
videos.description:
Was the 2020 election stolen? Well, no. But a lot of people seemed to think it was. 
So, how hard is it, really, to commit election fraud? In this episode, we dig into how our voting system really works, and how we keep our elections secure.
